title: Forecasting Ionospheric Irregularities on GNSS Lines of Sight Using Dynamic Graphs with Ephemeris Conditioning
abstract: arXiv:2604.18379v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Most data-driven ionospheric models operate on gridded products, which do not preserve the time-varying sampling structure of satellite-based sensing. We instead model the ionosphere as a dynamic graph over ionospheric pierce points, with connectivity that evolves as satellite positions change. Because satellite trajectories are predictable, the graph topology over the forecast horizon can be constructed in advance. We exploit this property to condition forecasts on the future graph structure, which we term ephemeris conditioning. This enables prediction on lines of sight (LoS) that appear only in the forecast horizon. We evaluate our framework on Global Navigation Satellite System data from a co-located receiver pair in Singapore spanning 2023 to 2025. The task is forecasting irregularities defined by the Rate of TEC Index (ROTI) up to 2 hours ahead as per-node binary classification. The resulting model, IonoDGNN, achieves a Brier S

translated_title: 基于星历条件化动态图的GNSS视线电离层不规则性预测
translated_abstract: 大多数数据驱动的电离层模型基于网格化产品运行，这些产品无法保留基于卫星探测的时变采样结构。我们转而将电离层建模为以电离层穿刺点为节点的动态图，其连通性随卫星位置的变化而演化。由于卫星轨迹是可预测的，预测时段内的图拓扑结构可以提前构建。我们利用这一特性，将预测条件化于未来的图结构，并将其称为星历条件化。这使得模型能够对仅在预测时段内才出现的视线进行预测。我们在2023年至2025年期间新加坡一组共址接收机的全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）数据上评估了该框架。任务是将由TEC变化率指数（ROTI）定义的不规则性作为逐节点二分类问题进行预测，预测时长最长可达2小时。所得到的模型IonoDGNN取得了Brier S（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出IonoDGNN模型，将电离层建模为随卫星位置变化的动态图，并首创“星历条件化”方法——利用卫星轨道的可预测性将未来图结构纳入预测条件，从而实现对GNSS视线电离层不规则性（ROTI）最长2小时 ahead 的预测。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes IonoDGNN, which models the ionosphere as a dynamic graph over ionospheric pierce points and introduces "ephemeris conditioning"—leveraging the predictability of satellite trajectories to condition forecasts on the future graph structure—enabling forecasting of GNSS line-of-sight ionospheric irregularities (ROTI) up to 2 hours ahead.
